summary: Completed full e2e testing of Smart Alerts feature. All 14 features verified - Dashboard API returns smart_alerts array with typed alerts (cost_increase, margin_drop), Frontend renders Smart Alerts section with color-coded cards, type count badges, Chat AI references smart alerts context when answering questions about cost/margin.

issues: Recharts console warnings about chart width/height being -1 on initial load - this is a known ResponsiveContainer issue but charts render correctly after data loads

seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo data which generates cost_increase and margin_drop alerts (no low_stock alerts currently due to demo data timing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Alerts feature fully functional. Dashboard API returns smart_alerts array computed in real-time (not stored in DB). Current demo data produces 4 cost_increase alerts (Fresh Salmon +10.8%, Ground Beef +8.6%, Flour +6.2%, Unsalted Butter +6.2%) and 1 margin_drop alert (Weekly margin dropped 8.0pp from 91.5% to 83.5%). Chat AI includes smart alerts context in system prompt and correctly references them when users ask about costs/margins. All data-testid attributes present: smart-alerts-section, alert-type-counts, smart-alert-{i}.

design_review.smart_alerts_section: Good - clean card layout with Zap icon header and type count badges
design_review.alert_cards: Good - color-coded left borders (amber=stock, red=cost, violet=margin), proper icon backgrounds
design_review.kpi_cards: Good - all 6 KPI cards render with period comparisons
design_review.charts: Good - weekly trends and top items charts render after data loads
design_review.chat_responses: Good - AI provides structured responses with bullet points, actions, and references smart alerts
